trips.name: Devil's Throat Walkways
trips.description: Walk along 2,200 metres of footbridges to the iconic Devil's Throat viewpoint at Iguazu Falls. The fully accessible trail takes approximately 2 hours, accessed via the Ecological Train of the Jungle to Garganta del Diablo Station. Witness the massive river plunging into the gorge, with mist visible from over 7 km away.

attractions.name: Iguazu National Park (Full Park)
attractions.description: Explore the stunning Iguazu Falls and surrounding subtropical rainforest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

attractions.name: Guira Oga Wildlife Rescue
attractions.description: Visit a wildlife rehabilitation center dedicated to rescuing and caring for injured native animals.

attractions.name: Minas de Wanda
attractions.description: Discover the famous semi-precious gemstone mines of Wanda, known for amethyst and quartz crystals.

attractions.name: Jesuitical Missions
attractions.description: Full-day excursion to the historic Jesuit missions, a UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing colonial-era history.

attractions.name: Parque Nacional Do Iguaçu
attractions.description: Experience the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls with panoramic views of the Devil's Throat.

attractions.name: Parque Das Aves
attractions.description: Walk through aviaries housing over 1,300 birds of 130 species in the Atlantic Forest.
